GynCell Compass
BEST-FIT CELL LINES FOR YOUR RESEARCH QUESTION

Welcome to GynCell Compass.

A free, interactive community resource for exploring gynaecological cell lines and making cell line selection more transparent.

Developed alongside the review “Which Cell Line Is the Right One? - Rethinking Model Selection in Gynaecological Cancer Research” (currently under review), GynCell Compass integrates key cell line characteristics to support the selection of models suited to your biological question and experimental goals.

Start with your disease context, choose the characteristics that matter, and set them as Required or Preferred. Reorder categories to reflect your priorities, then compare candidate cell lines and their sources. There is no fixed hierarchy: different research questions call for different models. Use this as a starting point and critically assess each candidate’s relevance, identity, quality and experimental suitability.

We aim to keep this resource updated with the research community. Please contact the study’s authors with questions or concerns, to flag misleading information or findings that have been disproven since the latest update, or to suggest an important study for inclusion in a future version.

Shape your selection

Choose in any order. Move categories up to give their preferences higher priority.

How selection works

Required choices exclude nonmatches and unknowns. Preferred choices sort candidates in category priority order: the first preference takes precedence over all later ones. Ties are alphabetical. Unselected categories do not affect ranking.

Multiple choices within one category mean OR; requirements across categories mean AND. NA is shown as “Not available” and never treated as a negative result.
